method: Sequential isolated processes on the same Ryzen 9 9900X / RTX 5060 Ti, same native module as the compact-sample run. Nine-stone start, 49 inventory stones, seed 0, 1024 iterations, unmodified apps/excavator/config/mcts_cuda.yml (evaluation256, placement32/native128, CPU result32, four workers), one BLAS/OpenMP thread. Search-only timing. Baseline is the compact-sample run in excavator-mcts-compact-samples.json (runs.compact). Change: array-based diversity selection, vectorized score-map anchor cells and candidate scoring, one-gather kernel shifts, and reuse of per-floor gap components and per-grid excavator distances. Search configuration, RNG draws and native code unchanged.

pose_generation_profile.note: Timer-only scratch profiler (extends tests/profile_excavator_cuda_mcts.py timers); inclusive wall seconds, overlapping rows. Profiled searches: 160.50 s before, 135.20 s after.

parity.note: Full instrumented search comparing every call with the original module: score maps array-for-array (NaN-aware) and field-for-field including shared xy arrays; selections run the original on a cloned RandomState and must match chosen candidates and final RNG state.

full_suite.note: The 28 unsuccessful cases are the pre-existing set recorded in excavator-copy-impact-review.json; the scan-orientation score-map fixture failure produces byte-identical output on HEAD.
